# Blitz3D: Brushes

Reusable material settings applied to meshes, surfaces and entities.


Back to [[Blitz3D]] or the [[Command-Index]].

| Command | Returns | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [BrushAlpha](Blitz3D-Brushes#brushalpha) | None | Sets how see-through painted surfaces are. |
| [BrushBlend](Blitz3D-Brushes#brushblend) | None | Chooses how painted surfaces are mixed with what is already on the screen: 1 alpha (the default), 2 multiply, 3 add. |
| [BrushColor](Blitz3D-Brushes#brushcolor) | None | Sets the color the brush multiplies onto the surface: the red, green and blue parts range from 0 to 255 and are clamped. |
| [BrushFX](Blitz3D-Brushes#brushfx) | None | Switches extra effects on or off with a sum of flags: 1 full-bright (no lighting), 2 vertex colors replace the brush color, 4 flat shading, 8 no fog, 16 no back-face culling, so both sides of a triangle are drawn. |
| [BrushShininess](Blitz3D-Brushes#brushshininess) | None | Sets the strength of the specular highlight on painted surfaces. |
| [BrushTexture](Blitz3D-Brushes#brushtexture) | None | Puts a texture on one of the layers of the brush. |
| [CreateBrush](Blitz3D-Brushes#createbrush) | Int | Makes a brush: a bundle of look settings (color, alpha, shininess, blend mode, effects and up to eight textures) that you can apply in one go with [PaintEntity](Blitz3D-Entities#paintentity), [PaintMesh](Blitz3D-Meshes#paintmesh) or [PaintSurface](Blitz3D-Surfaces#paintsurface). |
| [FreeBrush](Blitz3D-Brushes#freebrush) | None | Releases a brush. |
| [GetBrushTexture](Blitz3D-Brushes#getbrushtexture) | Int | Returns the texture on one layer of the brush, or 0 if there is none. |
| [GetEntityBrush](Blitz3D-Brushes#getentitybrush) | Int | Makes a new brush that has the same look as an entity: its color, alpha, shininess, blend mode, effects and textures. |
| [GetSurfaceBrush](Blitz3D-Brushes#getsurfacebrush) | Int | Makes a new brush that has the look that was painted on a mesh surface. |
| [LoadBrush](Blitz3D-Brushes#loadbrush) | Int | Makes a brush that has a texture loaded from a picture file as its first layer, and returns it. |

### BrushAlpha

```blitzbasic
BrushAlpha brush%, alpha#
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Sets how see-through painted surfaces are. 1 is solid, 0 is invisible and values between give glass-like surfaces. Values outside 0 to 1 are clamped.

A surface with alpha 0 is not drawn but still takes part in collisions, which is the difference to [HideEntity](Blitz3D-Entities#hideentity).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | Int | required | The brush. |
| `alpha` | Float | required | Opacity, 0 to 1. The default is 1. |

### BrushBlend

```blitzbasic
BrushBlend brush%, blend%
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Chooses how painted surfaces are mixed with what is already on the screen: 1 alpha (the default), 2 multiply, 3 add. Any other number selects the default.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | Int | required | The brush. |
| `blend` | Int | required | 1, 2 or 3. |

### BrushColor

```blitzbasic
BrushColor brush%, red#, green#, blue#
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Sets the color the brush multiplies onto the surface: the red, green and blue parts range from 0 to 255 and are clamped. The default is 255, 255, 255, which leaves textures unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | Int | required | The brush. |
| `red` | Float | required | Red part, 0 to 255. |
| `green` | Float | required | Green part, 0 to 255. |
| `blue` | Float | required | Blue part, 0 to 255. |

### BrushFX

```blitzbasic
BrushFX brush%, fx%
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Switches extra effects on or off with a sum of flags: 1 full-bright (no lighting), 2 vertex colors replace the brush color, 4 flat shading, 8 no fog, 16 no back-face culling, so both sides of a triangle are drawn. A value of 0 removes all effects.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | Int | required | The brush. |
| `fx` | Int | required | Sum of the flags above. |

### BrushShininess

```blitzbasic
BrushShininess brush%, shininess#
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Sets the strength of the specular highlight on painted surfaces. 0 gives matt surfaces and 1 a very shiny, billiard-ball look when a light shines on them.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | Int | required | The brush. |
| `shininess` | Float | required | Shininess, 0 to 1. The default is 0. |

### BrushTexture

```blitzbasic
BrushTexture brush%, texture%, frame%=0, index%=0
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Puts a texture on one of the layers of the brush. Layer 0 is the base texture, further layers are blended on top of it using [TextureBlend](Blitz3D-Textures#textureblend). For a texture from [LoadAnimTexture](Blitz3D-Textures#loadanimtexture) the frame chooses the cell to show.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraClsColor camera, 70, 100, 160
light = CreateLight()
RotateEntity light, 40, 30, 0

tex = CreateTexture(64, 64)
SetBuffer TextureBuffer(tex)
ClsColor 250, 240, 200
Cls
Color 190, 70, 40
Rect 0, 0, 32, 32, 1
Rect 32, 32, 32, 32, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()

brush = CreateBrush(255, 255, 255)
BrushTexture brush, tex
cube = CreateCube()
PositionEntity cube, 0, 0, 4.4
TurnEntity cube, 25, 35, 0
PaintEntity cube, brush
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```

![BrushTexture](media/brushes/brushtexture.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | Int | required | The brush. |
| `texture` | Int | required | The texture to put on the brush. |
| `frame` | Int | `0` | Frame of an animated texture. Defaults to 0. |
| `index` | Int | `0` | Layer number. Defaults to 0. |

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Layers 0 to 7 are accepted. The original help documents only 0 to 3 for this command.

### CreateBrush

```blitzbasic
CreateBrush red#=255, green#=255, blue#=255  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Makes a brush: a bundle of look settings (color, alpha, shininess, blend mode, effects and up to eight textures) that you can apply in one go with [PaintEntity](Blitz3D-Entities#paintentity), [PaintMesh](Blitz3D-Meshes#paintmesh) or [PaintSurface](Blitz3D-Surfaces#paintsurface). The new brush is opaque white with no texture unless you pass a color.

Brushes are the way to give different surfaces of one mesh a different look, because [EntityColor](Blitz3D-Entities#entitycolor) and [EntityAlpha](Blitz3D-Entities#entityalpha) affect the whole entity at once.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraClsColor camera, 70, 100, 160
light = CreateLight()
RotateEntity light, 40, 30, 0

mesh = CreateMesh()
a = CreateSurface(mesh)
AddVertex a, -1, 1, 0 : AddVertex a, 1, 1, 0 : AddVertex a, 1, -1, 0 : AddVertex a, -1, -1, 0
AddTriangle a, 0, 1, 2 : AddTriangle a, 0, 2, 3
b = CreateSurface(mesh)
AddVertex b, 1, 1, 0 : AddVertex b, 3, 1, 0 : AddVertex b, 3, -1, 0 : AddVertex b, 1, -1, 0
AddTriangle b, 0, 1, 2 : AddTriangle b, 0, 2, 3
UpdateNormals mesh

red = CreateBrush(220, 60, 50)
BrushShininess red, 0.8
green = CreateBrush(60, 190, 90)
PaintSurface a, red
PaintSurface b, green
FreeBrush red
FreeBrush green

PositionEntity mesh, -1, 0, 6
TurnEntity mesh, 0, -20, 0
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```

![CreateBrush](media/brushes/createbrush.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `red` | Float | `255` | Red part, 0 to 255. Defaults to 255. |
| `green` | Float | `255` | Green part, 0 to 255. Defaults to 255. |
| `blue` | Float | `255` | Blue part, 0 to 255. Defaults to 255. |

**Returns:** A brush handle.

### FreeBrush

```blitzbasic
FreeBrush brush%
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Releases a brush. Things that were painted with it keep the look they got, because painting copies the settings. Textures that were assigned to the brush are not freed by this, use [FreeTexture](Blitz3D-Textures#freetexture) for them.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | Int | required | The brush to free. |

### GetBrushTexture

```blitzbasic
GetBrushTexture brush%, index%=0  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Returns the texture on one layer of the brush, or 0 if there is none. Combine it with [TextureName](Blitz3D-Textures#texturename) to find out which file a painted surface uses.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | Int | required | The brush. |
| `index` | Int | `0` | Layer number, 0 to 7. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** A new handle for the texture of that layer, or 0. Free it separately when you no longer need it; the brush keeps its texture.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* A layer without a texture gives 0. The original hands out a handle to an empty texture instead.

### GetEntityBrush

```blitzbasic
GetEntityBrush entity%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Makes a new brush that has the same look as an entity: its color, alpha, shininess, blend mode, effects and textures. Free the brush with [FreeBrush](Blitz3D-Brushes#freebrush) when you no longer need it.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | Int | required | The entity. |

**Returns:** A brush handle.

### GetSurfaceBrush

```blitzbasic
GetSurfaceBrush surface%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Makes a new brush that has the look that was painted on a mesh surface. Free it with [FreeBrush](Blitz3D-Brushes#freebrush) afterwards.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `surface` | Int | required | The surface. |

**Returns:** A brush handle.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* A surface that was never painted gives a plain white brush.

### LoadBrush

```blitzbasic
LoadBrush file$, texture_flags%=1, u_scale#=1, v_scale#=1  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Makes a brush that has a texture loaded from a picture file as its first layer, and returns it. This is a shortcut for [LoadTexture](Blitz3D-Textures#loadtexture), [CreateBrush](Blitz3D-Brushes#createbrush) and [BrushTexture](Blitz3D-Brushes#brushtexture), including the optional [ScaleTexture](Blitz3D-Textures#scaletexture).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | String | required |  |
| `texture_flags` | Int | `1` |  |
| `u_scale` | Float | `1` | How often the texture repeats horizontally. Defaults to 1. |
| `v_scale` | Float | `1` | How often the texture repeats vertically. Defaults to 1. |

**Returns:** A brush handle, or 0 if the file could not be loaded.
